name: r1_cape_deciles
description: Subsequent 10-year annualized REAL total return of the S&P 500 by decile of starting Shiller CAPE (monthly starts 1926-01..2016-08).
caveats: Overlapping rolling windows are highly autocorrelated: effective independent sample sizes are far smaller than n_obs (e.g., ~9 independent 10y windows since 1926).
